comments.text: I got this yesterday! I am sorry but it is not very useful ....yet.  What I can see is you need to use some CUSTOM GPTs first. When I saw this on mine, I'd hoped it meant I could refer to other chats and bring their context into the current one.

I'm not so excited about having it access pre built GPT's, but having it access our other conversations would be great.

Another thing that would be kinda cool is to keep each individual chat separate so that they remain contextually relevant only to that specific conversation, but then be able to create a whole new chat and call several separate chats into it so you can pick and choose which to work with.

Not sure that made sense, but it's definitely something I would like to see.
